text: Duration of Study The study of CS&T program lasts 4 years in all and is composed of two periods. The first period of teaching and the last six months is for the students’ practice. It opens only when there are over 10 applicants. Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. The Key Courses The key courses which will be instructed in the first period of 3.5 years include: Introduction on Computer & Base on C Program Database Principle Programming in C Computer Network Computer Practice Technology of Compile Sports (I-III) Computer Architecture Advanced Mathematics A(I-II) Principles of Microcomputer and Interfacing Technology Probability Statistics Information Retrieval Java Programming English of Technical Terms Software Engineering Digital Logic Circuit Design ERP System Discrete Mathematics Digital Image Processing Data Structure Computer Graphics Operating System1 Financial Administration Electrotechnics Adjust accounts of Cost Computer Organization C# Programming Please click here to download the timetable of subjects
